name: White Bread with Bulgor
ingredients: 4-1/4 cups all-purpose flour (reserve 1/4 cup for dusting)
instructions: Combine water, 1/4 cup Bulgor wheat, and 1/8 teaspoon salt. Cover and bring to simmer. Simmer about 20 minutes or until most of water is absorbed. Cool to lukewarm[cite: 270, 272, 274, 275, 276, 279].
Dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup lukewarm water[cite: 285, 288]. [cite_start]Stir milk into the cooled Bulgor mixture[cite: 281, 284].
Sift together 4-1/4 cups flour, 2 teaspoons salt, and sugar (reserving 1/4 cup flour)[cite: 289, 290, 291, 292].
Add yeast mixture and cooked Bulgor to the flour mixture. [cite_start]Add shortening or oil and mix thoroughly[cite: 292, 293, 294, 295, 296].
Knead about 10 minutes or until dough is smooth. Form into ball. [cite_start]Place in warm greased bowl, brush with oil, cover, and let rise until doubled (1-1/2 to 2 hours)[cite: 297, 298].
Punch down dough, divide into 2 equal portions. [cite_start]Mould each into a ball, cover, and let rest for 15 minutes[cite: 299, 300, 301].
Shape into loaves and place in lightly greased loaf pans. [cite_start]Brush tops lightly with oil and let rise until volume is doubled[cite: 301, 302].
Bake in preheated oven, 400°F, 35 to 40 minutes[cite: 303].

name: Baked Banana Bulgor Custard
instructions: Blend all ingredients in a baking dish [cite: 305-318].
Sprinkle lightly with cinnamon[cite: 318].
Bake in moderate oven for 40 to 45 minutes or until set[cite: 319].

name: Banana Bulgor Cake
instructions: Combine 1/3 cup Bulgor Wheat and 1-1/3 cups water. [cite_start]Cover and simmer about 20 minutes or until most of water has been absorbed[cite: 323, 325, 327, 328].
Sift together flour, baking powder, and salt[cite: 329, 330, 331].
Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy[cite: 332, 335, 336]. [cite_start]Add eggs and beat until thick and creamy[cite: 333, 334, 337].
Blend cooked Bulgor, vanilla, mashed banana, and lemon juice[cite: 338, 339, 340, 341].
Add the flour mixture alternately with milk to the creamed mixture. [cite_start]Blend well after each addition[cite: 342, 344].
Turn into a greased 1-1/2 quart loaf pan[cite: 344].
Bake in a moderate oven, 350°F, about 1-1/4 hours[cite: 345].

name: Bulgor Apricot Delight with Eggnog Sauce
ingredients: Eggnog Sauce: 1 egg, 1/2 cup sugar, 1 teaspoon vanilla, 2 tablespoons sherry or rum (optional), 1/2 cup heavy cream, whipped
instructions: Mix apricot nectar, water, salt, and Bulgor in saucepan. Cover and simmer (do not boil) over low heat until all juice is absorbed. [cite_start]Stir several times [cite: 350-354].
Stir in 3 tablespoons sugar. [cite_start]Cover and continue cooking over low heat for 5 minutes[cite: 355, 356, 358, 359].
Chill the mixture. [cite_start]Stir in 1 tablespoon lemon juice[cite: 359, 360].
To make the Eggnog Sauce: Beat egg until thick and lemon coloured. Gradually add sugar and vanilla. Add sherry or rum (optional). [cite_start]Fold in whipped cream [cite: 362-370].
Top each serving of Bulgor delight with Eggnog Sauce and one-half apricot[cite: 357, 361].
